majors.issue: The two settlement seeds use the same template: a cross road, a top row of ruined blocks, and a bottom-left/right walled compound with the same concrete slab plaza strip, shacks on its top edge, stalls on its bottom edge, a log seat and campfire in the middle, and water towers at the corners, with the same row of generator, bench and tyre props under the wall. Only the mirroring and shift change. At thumbnail size they read as one map.
majors.fix: Vary the compound shape (L, ring, palisade of scrap, no wall), the plaza material and size, where the stalls go and how the roads are laid out, per seed.

majors.issue: The same stamp sits twice side by side: two identical ruined flat-roof blocks at x~15-225, then two identical vine-covered apartment blocks at x~255-400, with the same vines, broken windows and door position.
majors.fix: Never place the same building variant next to itself. Mirror it or swap rubble/vine overlays, or choose a different husk.

majors.issue: Six identical rubble-mound stamps are lined up in a neat row on the dirt and on the slab plaza. Three of them straddle the slab's top edge, so they look pasted on rather than collapsed in place. It reads as a stamp pattern, not debris.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-A/rc5-slab.png (mounds at top-left row and the middle row across the slab)
majors.fix: Limit any one mound variant to 1-2 per block, jitter positions off the grid, and keep mounds fully on one ground type or add a rubble spill transition.

majors.issue: The dirt field is a fixed 4x4-cell macro block that repeats. Shifting by 64 px leaves 55-73% of pixels identical on shanty-3/6, versus about 27% at a 16 px shift. In open areas the dark crater smudges and pebble clusters recur in a regular lattice at 1x. The base texture is also uniform per-pixel grey/brown speckle (TV static), unlike the smoother Beodeul packed dirt.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-A/sh6-band.png (smudges at a regular ~4-cell pitch), /tmp/vqa-r2-A/shanty3-dirt.png; g-dirt-field2x.png 128px@2x period 95.5% identical
majors.fix: Place dirt variants per cell with a hash (not a tiled 4x4 block) and lower the frequency of the high-contrast smudge variant. Reduce single-pixel speckle density and add larger soft value clumps.

majors.target: wasteland slab ground (g-slab-field1x, ruined-city lots, settlement plazas)
majors.issue: The slab field repeats with an 8-cell period (96% identical at a 128 px shift). The same crack lines and the brown chip at every seam T-joint recur, so a visible grid appears even on medium plazas. Slab areas also have hard straight rectangular edges against dirt, with no broken edge or rubble transition.
majors.evidence: g-slab-field1x.png (top and bottom halves identical), /tmp/vqa-r2-A/rc2-lot.png (seam chips at each joint), /tmp/vqa-r2-A/set1-compound.png plaza
majors.fix: Randomise slab variant per cell, drop the chip from most joints, and add slab-edge autotile pieces (cracked, missing corner) where the slab meets dirt.

majors.issue: The road texture is a blue-grey herringbone/zigzag hatch that repeats every cell horizontally. It reads as woven cobbles or a stream, not cracked asphalt. There is no curb or edge line and no worn or broken asphalt; the edge is just speckle against dirt. Intersections are plain overlaps.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-A/rc2-road.png (regular chevrons along the whole road), asphalt gate image on wl-pieces-3x.png
majors.fix: Use a darker, near-neutral asphalt with a low-frequency mottle, sparse cracks and potholes, a faded lane line, and edge autotiles with crumbling borders. Break the per-cell chevron rhythm.

majors.issue: Cobbled roads run straight across the dirt cliff bands. The cliff just stops at the road edge and resumes on the other side, with no ramp or stairs and no change in the road, which reads as impossible terrain.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-A/min7-cliffroad.png (road columns at left and right cut through the ledge), /tmp/vqa-r2-A/min2-mid.png (centre road)
majors.fix: Use ramp/stair pieces where a road crosses a ledge, or route roads around ledges.

majors.target: mining-7.png right forest, temple-ruins-5.png forest masses
majors.issue: The forest blobs have hard rectangular, stair-stepped cut edges. Canopies are sliced vertically and horizontally, leaving half-trees and trunks floating under clipped canopies, especially at mining-7 x~840-900 y~440-520 and the left and lower edges of the temple-ruins-5 forest.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r2-A/min7-yard.png (right side), /tmp/vqa-r2-A/tr5-forest.png (left edge x~100-130 crop, step cuts)
majors.fix: Use the forest edge/fringe pieces (whole tree silhouettes) on the blob perimeter, never cut canopy tiles at a cell boundary.

majors.issue: The base grass tile carries a dark-green glyph-like motif that repeats every 16 px, so there is a visible 16 px grid of identical marks across every open lawn at 1x. It is most obvious next to the new yard ground.
majors.fix: Add grass variants per cell (or a larger macro tile) and soften the motif contrast. If this is the pre-existing grass, at least randomise the variants under the village quarter.

majors.issue: The flagstone temple yard is the same stamp in both seeds: shrine top-left, temple centre, two columns, a broken block left, a cypress right, and the same notched outline. Only its position on the map changes.
majors.fix: Randomise the yard outline, the prop set (fallen column, altar, statue base, overgrown steps) and the temple orientation per seed.

minors.issue: wall-h is one stamp repeated 3-4 times in a row, and the vertical wall is a chain of separate blocks with dirt gaps. A stray wall-h block sits outside the compound at bottom-right.
minors.fix: Join the wall pieces, add breach and end-cap pieces, and remove orphan segments.

minors.issue: Both use a near-identical 3x3 street grid (vertical roads at about x=245 and 565-580 and the same horizontal road rows).
minors.fix: Vary block sizes, add diagonal or dead-end streets and collapsed overpasses.

minors.issue: Same template: a single road along the top, scattered shacks and tents, and a water tower near the centre.
minors.fix: Vary the road position and cluster the shacks around a feature (dry riverbed, scrap wall, well).

minors.issue: The mine adit stands freestanding on flat dirt with no hillside or rock face behind it, and the yard is a plain rounded rectangle.
minors.fix: Back the adit against a cliff ledge or rock mound, and add spoil heaps or cart tracks.

minors.issue: The puddle is a flat two-tone dark blue blob with no rim or highlight. On the maps it reads as a black hole or tar.
minors.fix: Add a lighter reflection pixel row, a damp darker dirt rim and a muddy edge.
